name: Docker no-new-privileges Enabled by Default
description: Ensures the Docker daemon starts containers with no-new-privileges ("no-new-privileges": true), so processes cannot gain privileges through set-UID binaries. Passes with LEA_RULE_no_service when dockerd is not running.

validation.command: if cat /proc/*/comm 2>/dev/null | grep -q '^dockerd$'; then cat /etc/docker/daemon.json 2>/dev/null; echo LEA_DOCKER; else echo 'LEA_RULE_no_service'; fi
